llm.summary: This skill is a straightforward SocialEcho API helper that uses an explicit team API key to query data and publish posts when the user runs those commands.

dimensions.detail: The capability set matches the stated SocialEcho social media management purpose, including account/report queries, upload URL retrieval, and post publishing with a team API key.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions require explicit CLI arguments for the API key, base URL, team ID, language, account IDs, and publish payload; the scripts do not auto-read environment variables or hidden local profiles.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package has no dependencies and no npm lifecycle install scripts; setup is limited to npm ci and exposes CLI entry points.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Network calls and transmission of API keys, query parameters, and publish payloads to SocialEcho are expected for this integration; users should avoid overriding the base URL unless they trust the endpoint.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill does not create local persistence or background workers, but publish operations can create drafts or live social posts through SocialEcho when explicitly invoked.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you intend to let the agent call SocialEcho with a team API key. Review publish payloads, account IDs, status values, scheduled times, and the base URL before running publish commands, and use a least-privilege or revocable API key where possible.
llm.findings: [SQP-2] expected: The scanner concern about API-key use and publishing side effects is materially relevant, but the artifacts disclose external SocialEcho API use, required explicit credentials, and a publish command; this supports user guidance rather than a Review verdict.
